Settings
Configure your tool and manage your data.
📋 Bet Sources
Manage the sources available when logging a bet. Tag each as Own (own-study checklist) or Tip (tip checklist).
💰 Starting Bank
Set your starting bankroll. This is used to calculate ROI and growth percentage. Your current bank is updated from the Bank card.
🟢 Virtual Bank
Set your virtual paper trading bank. Adjust the starting amount or reset the current balance at any time.
🏇 Racing API
Connect to theracingapi.com to search horse profiles, auto-fill trainer and jockey, and pull today's entries. Use your account username and password.
💡 Credentials stored only in this browser's localStorage. If you get 401 errors, tap Clear & Reset then re-enter your details and Save.
🤖 AI Coach
The Coach uses Claude AI to give you personalised advice based on your actual betting data. It knows your bank, your recent bets, your rules and your P&L.

Get a free API key at console.anthropic.com → API Keys.
💡 Your key is stored only in this browser's localStorage. It is never sent anywhere except directly to Anthropic's API.
